response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, hands-on senior engineer with ~18 years of experience across web, mobile, and backend systems, including genuine high-scale work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic and recent AI-agent tooling experience. However, the resume shows no experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or telemetry platform experience — the core domain of this role — and no evidence of Principal/IC6-level scope such as leading multi-team initiatives or building platforms adopted across an enterprise. His trajectory is strong senior/staff IC work at small-to-mid companies, which falls short of the cross-org technical leadership and growth-measurement expertise this position demands.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (18+ years) across many languages and stacks, including required Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++
Real high-scale distributed systems experience (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Recent hands-on AI tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) matching the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or metrics/telemetry platform experience anywhere in the resume
No demonstrated Principal-level scope: no multi-team initiative leadership, cross-org platform ownership, or stakeholder alignment at enterprise scale
Career mostly at small companies/startups; no evidence of data science partnership, statistical analysis, or growth-engineering work

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
